mapper.select:
SELECT c_room.room_id, c_room.room_type,
CASE WHEN c_room.room_type = 'ONE' THEN COALESCE(other_sawon.saname, c_room.room_name) ELSE c_room.room_name END AS room_name,
c_room.created_at, c_member.joined_at, lm.sent_at, lm.content AS last_message, CASE WHEN DATE(lm.sent_at) = CURDATE() THEN DATE_FORMAT(lm.sent_at, '%H:%i') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(lm.sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d') END AS last_message_time, c_member.liked FROM chat_room c_room
JOIN chat_member c_member ON c_room.room_id = c_member.room_id
LEFT JOIN chat_member other_member ON c_room.room_type = 'ONE' AND c_room.room_id = other_member.room_id AND other_member.sabun != #{sabun}
LEFT JOIN sawon other_sawon ON c_room.room_type = 'ONE' AND other_member.sabun = other_sawon.sabun
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, content, sent_at FROM chat_message WHERE (room_id, message_id) IN ( SELECT room_id, MAX(message_id) FROM chat_message GROUP BY room_id ) ) lm ON c_room.room_id = lm.room_id
WHERE c_member.sabun = #{sabun}
ORDER BY lm.sent_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into chat_message(room_id, sender_sabun, saname, content, sent_at) values(#{room_id}, #{sender_sabun}, #{saname}, #{content}, now());
mapper.select: select message_id, room_id, sender_sabun, content, saname, sent_at, CASE WHEN DATE(sent_at) = CURDATE() THEN DATE_FORMAT(sent_at, '%H:%i') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d') END AS sent_time from chat_message where room_id = #{room_id} order by sent_at desc limit #{limit}

select message_id, room_id, sender_sabun, content, saname, sent_at, CASE WHEN DATE(sent_at) = CURDATE() THEN DATE_FORMAT(sent_at, '%H:%i') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d') END AS sent_time from chat_message where room_id = #{room_id} and message_id < #{lastLogId} order by sent_at desc limit #{limit}
select sabun from chat_member where room_id = #{room_id}
select liked from chat_member where room_id=#{room_id} and sabun=#{sabun}
mapper.update: update chat_member set liked=#{liked} where room_id=#{room_id} and sabun=#{sabun}

CASE WHEN c_room.room_type = 'ONE' THEN COALESCE(other_sawon.saname, c_room.room_name) ELSE c_room.room_name END AS room_name,
c_room.created_at, c_member.joined_at, lm.sent_at, lm.content AS last_message, CASE WHEN DATE(lm.sent_at) = CURDATE() THEN DATE_FORMAT(lm.sent_at, '%H:%i') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(lm.sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d') END AS last_message_time, c_member.liked FROM chat_room c_room
JOIN chat_member c_member ON c_room.room_id = c_member.room_id
LEFT JOIN chat_member other_member ON c_room.room_type = 'ONE' AND c_room.room_id = other_member.room_id AND other_member.sabun != #{sabun}
LEFT JOIN sawon other_sawon ON c_room.room_type = 'ONE' AND other_member.sabun = other_sawon.sabun
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, content, sent_at FROM chat_message WHERE (room_id, message_id) IN ( SELECT room_id, MAX(message_id) FROM chat_message GROUP BY room_id ) ) lm ON c_room.room_id = lm.room_id
WHERE c_member.sabun = #{sabun} and c_member.liked = true ORDER BY lm.sent_at DESC

SELECT cr.room_id FROM chat_room cr JOIN chat_member cm1 ON cr.room_id = cm1.room_id JOIN chat_member cm2 ON cr.room_id = cm2.room_id WHERE cr.room_type = 'ONE' AND cm1.sabun = #{mySabun} AND cm2.sabun = #{targetSabun} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET room_name = (SELECT saname FROM sawon WHERE sabun = #{sabun}) WHERE room_id = #{room_id} AND room_type = 'ONE'

mapper.delete: delete from chat_member where sabun=#{sabun} and room_id=#{room_id}
